tests_added_or_updated: 172 new independent tests added (tests/test_cltr_authority_136ak_recovery_concurrency_independent.py: 170 fast + 2 @pytest.mark.slow packaging tests), all passing. No fixture, helper, or expected-value table imported from Phase 136AJ's own test module; every fixture (_cc_wire, _rje_wire, enum-member tuples) was independently re-derived directly from the live executable schemas. summary: Phase 136AK independently verifies Phase 136AJ's ConcurrencyConflict/RecoveryJournalEntry typed record models (src/pcae/cltr/authority/recovery_concurrency.py) against the live executable schemas (records/concurrency_conflict.schema.json, records/recovery_journal_entry.schema.json) and the shared component schemas they compose, deliberately not trusting Phase 136AJ's own field tables, fixtures, tests, helpers, comments, decisions, or prior verification reports. New standalone test module tests/test_cltr_authority_136ak_recovery_concurrency_independent.py (172 tests: 170 fast + 2 packaging, all passing), independently fixtured, using the shared pcae.schema_runtime offline schema-validation registry as an independent oracle. No Blocking defect was found; no repair to recovery_concurrency.py was required or performed. Independently confirmed: exactly eleven implemented record-family classes exist and the five later-group families do not; every required/optional/nullable field classification for both models matches the live schema exactly; both conditional pairs (type=='cas_mismatch' <-> expected_state/observed_state; sequence==0 <-> null prior_entry_digest; state <-> operator_review/recovery_action) are strict biconditionals in both directions; no unauthorized semantic strengthening (retry-requires-failure, rollback-requires-publication, resume-requires-checkpoint, conflict-requires-expected-ne-observed) is enforced anywhere the schema does not itself encode it; wrong-family reference substitutions fail while valid-but-nonexistent references succeed with zero lookup (confirmed with open() monkeypatched to raise); every enum's valid members, invalid values (wrong case, whitespace, null, int, bool), and omission behavior were independently exercised; both models are recursively immutable (mutating source lists/dicts after construction never affects the model) and use strict structural equality (never identifier-only or digest-only); construction errors are deterministic across repeated attempts; zero side effects observed under active socket/subprocess/filesystem-write instrumentation across import, construction, serialization, equality, and repr(); no production runtime module imports pcae.cltr.authority. Fresh wheel/sdist build plus isolated installed-wheel verification (outside the repository checkout) confirmed all eleven record-family models import and both recovery/concurrency models construct and round-trip. Findings disclosed, none Blocking: CONFIRMED-136AC-1 (inherited, unchanged -- bare ValueError on enum construction), CONFIRMED-136AE-2 (inherited stale wheel-packaging guard, reproduced identically, unrelated to the two recovery/concurrency models), NON-BLOCKING-136AK-1 (re-confirmation that operation_reference/prior_state_reference/new_state_reference carry no family restriction, matching the schema's own NON-BLOCKING-136R-3 disclosure), NON-BLOCKING-136AK-2 (the 136AJ report's recorded full-quick-tier-sweep baseline, 22942/23/9, does not match a freshly isolated re-measurement of the identical pre-136AK commit f655f133, 22937/28/9 -- independently confirmed via git-stash isolation as a pre-existing report-figure discrepancy, not a regression; the same 28 failing test IDs, byte-for-byte, appear in both the pre-136AK isolated baseline and this phase's own sweep). Regression: 1596 passed / 1 skipped across all eleven test_cltr_authority_136* modules together; Fast Green 4391 passed, 0 failed (matching the 136AJ-recorded baseline exactly); full bounded quick-tier sweep 23107 passed / 28 failed / 9 skipped, with all 28 failures independently confirmed present, byte-for-byte identical, on a git-stash-isolated pre-136AK checkout (zero regression). Runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Verdict: RECOVERY AND CONCURRENCY MODELS VERIFIED WITH NO NEW BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR NOTIFICATION AUTHORITY BINDING IMPLEMENTATION.
